narr.The Canton Library: The Canton Library opened on 8 September 2026, so there is no last-year line. W36 users 2,544 with 37 GA4 bookings; conversion rate 1.5%, up from 0.8%, the best of the four weeks on the smallest traffic base. Meta’s conversions campaign delivered 11 bookings at HK$838 CPA, better than HK$1,134 the week before; the awareness campaign (HK$3,045 this week) optimises to landing page views and carries no cost per booking.
